description: Ministry of Labour - Amendment to the Regulations made Under the Employees Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Labour under the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958. It involves amendments to existing regulations, specifying legal requirements and procedures for employers and employees regarding provident fund contributions and documentation. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
